name: Oneclick Logistics India Ltd.
summary: Oneclick Logistics India Ltd. is an Indian freight forwarding and logistics company that provides end-to-end integrated logistics solutions. The company's primary services include air and ocean freight, warehousing, custom house brokerage, project cargo, and clearing and forwarding services. They also offer road freight, bulk cargo handling, and allied logistics and transportation services, encompassing supply chain management. Oneclick Logistics primarily serves importers in India, facilitating goods movement from regions such as China, Europe, Singapore, and Malaysia, and caters to a diverse range of industries including automotive, heavy engineering, telecom, food, agriculture, fast-moving consumer goods, and paint. The company operates in major Indian ports and utilizes an asset-light business model by partnering with third-party transport providers, container freight stations, shipping lines, and airlines.
